description: Minified JavaScript source code for the jQuery Vector Map Library (JQVMap), including class definitions for VectorCanvas, ColorScale, and JQVMap, as well as methods for map rendering, interaction, and transformations.
external_files: map data files (e.g., map definitions in d.paths)

classes.name: VectorCanvas
classes.description: Handles creation and manipulation of SVG or VML canvas for map rendering.

classes.name: ColorScale
classes.description: Manages color scaling and normalization for map data visualization.

classes.name: JQVMap
classes.description: Main class for initializing and controlling the vector map, including region selection, zoom, and interaction.

methods.name: createSvgNode
methods.description: Creates an SVG element with the specified tag name.

methods.name: createVmlNode
methods.description: Creates a VML element with the specified tag name.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the SVG or VML canvas.

methods.name: applyTransform
methods.description: Applies current transformation parameters to the map.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new SVG or VML group element.

methods.name: createPath
methods.description: Creates a path element for the map regions.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the zoom scale of the map.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Assigns data values to regions for color scaling.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the map according to container dimensions.
